source.title: 128 Civics Questions and Answers (2025 version)
source.spanishTranslation: Supplemental app translation; English questions and answers are the official source.

questions.question: What is the form of government of the United States?
questions.spanish: ¿Cuál es la forma de gobierno de los Estados Unidos?

questions.question: What is the supreme law of the land?
questions.spanish: ¿Cuál es la ley suprema del país?

questions.question: Name one thing the U.S. Constitution does.
answers: Protects the rights of the people
questions.spanish: Mencione una cosa que hace la Constitución de los Estados Unidos.

questions.question: The U.S. Constitution starts with the words “We the People.” What does “We the People” mean?
questions.spanish: La Constitución de los Estados Unidos comienza con las palabras “Nosotros, el Pueblo”. ¿Qué significa “Nosotros, el Pueblo”?

questions.question: How are changes made to the U.S. Constitution?
questions.spanish: ¿Cómo se hacen cambios a la Constitución de los Estados Unidos?

questions.question: What does the Bill of Rights protect?
answers: (The basic) rights of people living in the United States
questions.spanish: ¿Qué protege la Carta de Derechos?

questions.question: How many amendments does the U.S. Constitution have?
questions.spanish: ¿Cuántas enmiendas tiene la Constitución de los Estados Unidos?

questions.question: Why is the Declaration of Independence important?
answers: It says America is free from British control.
It says all people are created equal.
questions.spanish: ¿Por qué es importante la Declaración de Independencia?

questions.question: What founding document said the American colonies were free from Britain?
questions.spanish: ¿Qué documento fundacional declaró que las colonias estadounidenses eran libres de Gran Bretaña?

questions.question: Name two important ideas from the Declaration of Independence and the U.S. Constitution.
questions.spanish: Mencione dos ideas importantes de la Declaración de Independencia y la Constitución de los Estados Unidos.

questions.question: The words “Life, Liberty, and the pursuit of Happiness” are in what founding document?
questions.spanish: ¿En qué documento fundacional aparecen las palabras “Vida, Libertad y la búsqueda de la Felicidad”?

questions.question: What is the economic system of the United States?
questions.spanish: ¿Cuál es el sistema económico de los Estados Unidos?

questions.question: What is the rule of law?
answers: No one is above the law.
questions.spanish: ¿Qué significa el estado de derecho?

questions.question: Many documents influenced the U.S. Constitution. Name one.
questions.spanish: Muchos documentos influyeron en la Constitución de los Estados Unidos. Mencione uno.

questions.question: There are three branches of government. Why?
answers: So one part does not become too powerful
questions.spanish: Hay tres ramas del gobierno. ¿Por qué?

questions.question: Name the three branches of government.
questions.spanish: Mencione las tres ramas del gobierno.

questions.question: The President of the United States is in charge of which branch of government?
questions.spanish: ¿De qué rama del gobierno está a cargo el Presidente de los Estados Unidos?

questions.question: What part of the federal government writes laws?
questions.spanish: ¿Qué parte del gobierno federal redacta las leyes?

questions.question: What are the two parts of the U.S. Congress?
questions.spanish: ¿Cuáles son las dos partes del Congreso de los Estados Unidos?

questions.question: Name one power of the U.S. Congress.
questions.spanish: Mencione un poder del Congreso de los Estados Unidos.

questions.question: How many U.S. senators are there?
questions.spanish: ¿Cuántos senadores estadounidenses hay?

questions.question: How long is a term for a U.S. senator?
questions.spanish: ¿Cuánto dura el mandato de un senador estadounidense?

questions.question: Who is one of your state’s U.S. senators now?
answers: Answers will vary. [District of Columbia residents and residents of U.S. territories should answer that D.C. (or the territory where the applicant lives) has no U.S. senators.]
questions.spanish: ¿Quién es actualmente uno de los senadores estadounidenses de su estado?

questions.question: How many voting members are in the House of Representatives?
questions.spanish: ¿Cuántos miembros con derecho a voto hay en la Cámara de Representantes?

questions.question: How long is a term for a member of the House of Representatives?
questions.spanish: ¿Cuánto dura el mandato de un miembro de la Cámara de Representantes?

questions.question: Why do U.S. representatives serve shorter terms than U.S. senators?
answers: To more closely follow public opinion
questions.spanish: ¿Por qué los representantes de los Estados Unidos tienen mandatos más cortos que los senadores?

questions.question: How many senators does each state have?
questions.spanish: ¿Cuántos senadores tiene cada estado?

questions.question: Why does each state have two senators?
questions.spanish: ¿Por qué cada estado tiene dos senadores?

questions.question: Name your U.S. representative.
answers: Answers will vary. [Residents of territories with nonvoting Delegates or Resident Commissioners may provide the name of that Delegate or Commissioner. Also acceptable is any statement that the territory has no (voting) representatives in Congress.]
questions.spanish: Mencione el nombre de su representante de los Estados Unidos.

questions.question: What is the name of the Speaker of the House of Representatives now?
answers: Visit uscis.gov/citizenship/testupdates for the name of the Speaker of the House of Representatives.
questions.spanish: ¿Cuál es el nombre del Presidente de la Cámara de Representantes actualmente?

questions.question: Who does a U.S. senator represent?
questions.spanish: ¿A quién representa un senador estadounidense?

questions.question: Who elects U.S. senators?
questions.spanish: ¿Quién elige a los senadores estadounidenses?

questions.question: Who does a member of the House of Representatives represent?
questions.spanish: ¿A quién representa un miembro de la Cámara de Representantes?

questions.question: Who elects members of the House of Representatives?
questions.spanish: ¿Quién elige a los miembros de la Cámara de Representantes?

questions.question: Some states have more representatives than other states. Why?
questions.spanish: Algunos estados tienen más representantes que otros estados. ¿Por qué?

questions.question: The President of the United States is elected for how many years?
questions.spanish: ¿Por cuántos años es elegido el Presidente de los Estados Unidos?

questions.question: The President of the United States can serve only two terms. Why?
answers: To keep the president from becoming too powerful
questions.spanish: El Presidente de los Estados Unidos solo puede servir dos mandatos. ¿Por qué?

questions.question: What is the name of the President of the United States now?
answers: Visit uscis.gov/citizenship/testupdates for the name of the President of the United States.
questions.spanish: ¿Cuál es el nombre del Presidente de los Estados Unidos actualmente?

questions.question: What is the name of the Vice President of the United States now?
answers: Visit uscis.gov/citizenship/testupdates for the name of the Vice President of the United States.
questions.spanish: ¿Cuál es el nombre del Vicepresidente de los Estados Unidos actualmente?

questions.question: If the president can no longer serve, who becomes president?
answers: The Vice President (of the United States)
questions.spanish: Si el presidente ya no puede ejercer el cargo, ¿quién se convierte en presidente?

questions.question: Name one power of the president.
questions.spanish: Mencione un poder del presidente.

questions.question: Who is Commander in Chief of the U.S. military?
questions.spanish: ¿Quién es el Comandante en Jefe de las fuerzas militares de los Estados Unidos?

questions.question: Who signs bills to become laws?
questions.spanish: ¿Quién firma los proyectos de ley para convertirlos en leyes?

questions.question: Who vetoes bills?
questions.spanish: ¿Quién veta los proyectos de ley?

questions.question: Who appoints federal judges?
questions.spanish: ¿Quién nombra a los jueces federales?

questions.question: The executive branch has many parts. Name one.
questions.spanish: La rama ejecutiva tiene muchas partes. Mencione una.

questions.question: What does the President’s Cabinet do?
answers: Advises the President (of the United States)
questions.spanish: ¿Qué hace el Gabinete del Presidente?

questions.question: What are two Cabinet-level positions?
answers: Secretary of Health and Human Services
Secretary of Housing and Urban Development
Administrator of the Environmental Protection Agency
Administrator of the Small Business Administration
Director of the Central Intelligence Agency
Director of the Office of Management and Budget
questions.spanish: ¿Cuáles son dos cargos a nivel de Gabinete?

questions.question: Why is the Electoral College important?
answers: It decides who is elected president.
It provides a compromise between the popular election of the president and congressional selection.
questions.spanish: ¿Por qué es importante el Colegio Electoral?

questions.question: What is one part of the judicial branch?
questions.spanish: ¿Cuál es una parte de la rama judicial?

questions.question: What does the judicial branch do?
answers: Decides if a law goes against the (U.S.) Constitution
questions.spanish: ¿Qué hace la rama judicial?

questions.question: What is the highest court in the United States?
questions.spanish: ¿Cuál es el tribunal más alto de los Estados Unidos?

questions.question: How many seats are on the Supreme Court?
questions.spanish: ¿Cuántos puestos hay en la Corte Suprema?

questions.question: How many Supreme Court justices are usually needed to decide a case?
questions.spanish: ¿Cuántos jueces de la Corte Suprema suelen ser necesarios para decidir un caso?

questions.question: How long do Supreme Court justices serve?
questions.spanish: ¿Cuánto tiempo sirven los jueces de la Corte Suprema?

questions.question: Supreme Court justices serve for life. Why?
questions.spanish: Los jueces de la Corte Suprema sirven de por vida. ¿Por qué?

questions.question: Who is the Chief Justice of the United States now?
answers: Visit uscis.gov/citizenship/testupdates for the name of the Chief Justice of the United States.
questions.spanish: ¿Quién es actualmente el Presidente de la Corte Suprema de los Estados Unidos?

questions.question: Name one power that is only for the federal government.
questions.spanish: Mencione un poder que corresponde únicamente al gobierno federal.

questions.question: Name one power that is only for the states.
questions.spanish: Mencione un poder que corresponde únicamente a los estados.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the 10th Amendment?
answers: (It states that the) powers not given to the federal government belong to the states or to the people.
questions.spanish: ¿Cuál es el propósito de la Décima Enmienda?

questions.question: Who is the governor of your state now?
answers: Answers will vary. [District of Columbia residents should answer that D.C. does not have a governor.]
questions.spanish: ¿Quién es actualmente el gobernador de su estado?

questions.question: What is the capital of your state?
answers: Answers will vary. [District of Columbia residents should answer that D.C. is not a state and does not have a capital. Residents of U.S. territories should name the capital of the territory.]
questions.spanish: ¿Cuál es la capital de su estado?

questions.question: There are four amendments to the U.S. Constitution about who can vote. Describe one of them.
answers: You don’t have to pay (a poll tax) to vote.
Any citizen can vote. (Women and men can vote.)
A male citizen of any race (can vote).
questions.spanish: Hay cuatro enmiendas a la Constitución de los Estados Unidos sobre quién puede votar. Describa una de ellas.

questions.question: Who can vote in federal elections, run for federal office, and serve on a jury in the United States?
questions.spanish: ¿Quién puede votar en las elecciones federales, postularse para un cargo federal y servir en un jurado en los Estados Unidos?

questions.question: What are three rights of everyone living in the United States?
questions.spanish: ¿Cuáles son tres derechos de todas las personas que viven en los Estados Unidos?

questions.question: What do we show loyalty to when we say the Pledge of Allegiance?
questions.spanish: ¿A qué mostramos lealtad cuando decimos el Juramento de Lealtad?

questions.question: Name two promises that new citizens make in the Oath of Allegiance.
answers: Give up loyalty to other countries
Obey the laws of the United States
Serve (help, do important work for) the nation (if needed)
Be loyal to the United States
questions.spanish: Mencione dos promesas que hacen los nuevos ciudadanos en el Juramento de Lealtad.

questions.question: How can people become United States citizens?
answers: Be born in the United States, under the conditions set by the 14th Amendment
Derive citizenship (under conditions set by Congress)
questions.spanish: ¿Cómo pueden las personas convertirse en ciudadanos de los Estados Unidos?

questions.question: What are two examples of civic participation in the United States?
answers: Give an elected official your opinion (on an issue)
Support or oppose an issue or policy
questions.spanish: ¿Cuáles son dos ejemplos de participación cívica en los Estados Unidos?

questions.question: What is one way Americans can serve their country?
answers: Work for local, state, or federal government
questions.spanish: ¿Cuál es una manera en que los estadounidenses pueden servir a su país?

questions.question: Why is it important to pay federal taxes?
answers: All people pay to fund the federal government
questions.spanish: ¿Por qué es importante pagar impuestos federales?

questions.question: It is important for all men age 18 through 25 to register for the Selective Service. Name one reason why.
answers: Makes the draft fair, if needed
questions.spanish: Es importante que todos los hombres de 18 a 25 años se registren en el Servicio Selectivo. Mencione una razón.

questions.question: The colonists came to America for many reasons. Name one.
questions.spanish: Los colonos llegaron a América por muchas razones. Mencione una.

questions.question: Who lived in America before the Europeans arrived?
questions.spanish: ¿Quiénes vivían en América antes de que llegaran los europeos?

questions.question: What group of people was taken and sold as slaves?
questions.spanish: ¿Qué grupo de personas fue llevado y vendido como esclavos?

questions.question: What war did the Americans fight to win independence from Britain?
questions.spanish: ¿Qué guerra libraron los estadounidenses para obtener la independencia de Gran Bretaña?

questions.question: Name one reason why the Americans declared independence from Britain.
answers: British soldiers stayed in Americans’ houses (boarding, quartering)
questions.spanish: Mencione una razón por la cual los estadounidenses declararon su independencia de Gran Bretaña.

questions.question: Who wrote the Declaration of Independence?
questions.spanish: ¿Quién escribió la Declaración de Independencia?

questions.question: When was the Declaration of Independence adopted?
questions.spanish: ¿Cuándo fue adoptada la Declaración de Independencia?

questions.question: The American Revolution had many important events. Name one.
answers: Washington Crossing the Delaware (Battle of Trenton)
questions.spanish: La Revolución Americana tuvo muchos acontecimientos importantes. Mencione uno.

questions.question: There were 13 original states. Name five.
questions.spanish: Había 13 estados originales. Mencione cinco.

questions.question: What founding document was written in 1787?
questions.spanish: ¿Qué documento fundacional fue escrito en 1787?

questions.question: The Federalist Papers supported the passage of the U.S. Constitution. Name one of the writers.
questions.spanish: Los Documentos Federalistas apoyaron la aprobación de la Constitución de los Estados Unidos. Mencione uno de sus autores.

questions.question: Why were the Federalist Papers important?
answers: They helped people understand the (U.S.) Constitution.
questions.spanish: ¿Por qué fueron importantes los Documentos Federalistas?

questions.question: Benjamin Franklin is famous for many things. Name one.
answers: Founded the first free public libraries
First Postmaster General of the United States
Helped write the Declaration of Independence
questions.spanish: Benjamin Franklin es famoso por muchas cosas. Mencione una.

questions.question: George Washington is famous for many things. Name one.
answers: First president of the United States
questions.spanish: George Washington es famoso por muchas cosas. Mencione una.

questions.question: Thomas Jefferson is famous for many things. Name one.
answers: Writer of the Declaration of Independence
Third president of the United States
Doubled the size of the United States (Louisiana Purchase)
Writer of the Virginia Statute on Religious Freedom
questions.spanish: Thomas Jefferson es famoso por muchas cosas. Mencione una.

questions.question: James Madison is famous for many things. Name one.
answers: Fourth president of the United States
One of the writers of the Federalist Papers
questions.spanish: James Madison es famoso por muchas cosas. Mencione una.

questions.question: Alexander Hamilton is famous for many things. Name one.
answers: One of the writers of the Federalist Papers
Helped establish the First Bank of the United States
questions.spanish: Alexander Hamilton es famoso por muchas cosas. Mencione una.

questions.question: What territory did the United States buy from France in 1803?
questions.spanish: ¿Qué territorio compró Estados Unidos a Francia en 1803?

questions.question: Name one war fought by the United States in the 1800s.
questions.spanish: Mencione una guerra en la que Estados Unidos luchó durante el siglo XIX.

questions.question: Name the U.S. war between the North and the South.
questions.spanish: Mencione la guerra de Estados Unidos entre el Norte y el Sur.

questions.question: The Civil War had many important events. Name one.
questions.spanish: La Guerra Civil tuvo muchos acontecimientos importantes. Mencione uno.

questions.question: Abraham Lincoln is famous for many things. Name one.
answers: Led the United States during the Civil War
questions.spanish: Abraham Lincoln es famoso por muchas cosas. Mencione una.

questions.question: What did the Emancipation Proclamation do?
answers: Freed slaves in the Confederate states
Freed slaves in most Southern states
questions.spanish: ¿Qué hizo la Proclamación de Emancipación?

questions.question: What U.S. war ended slavery?
questions.spanish: ¿Qué guerra de Estados Unidos terminó con la esclavitud?

questions.question: What amendment says all persons born or naturalized in the United States, and subject to the jurisdiction thereof, are U.S. citizens?
questions.spanish: ¿Qué enmienda establece que todas las personas nacidas o naturalizadas en los Estados Unidos y sujetas a su jurisdicción son ciudadanos estadounidenses?

questions.question: When did all men get the right to vote?
questions.spanish: ¿Cuándo obtuvieron todos los hombres el derecho a votar?

questions.question: Name one leader of the women’s rights movement in the 1800s.
questions.spanish: Mencione una líder del movimiento por los derechos de las mujeres en el siglo XIX.

questions.question: Name one war fought by the United States in the 1900s.
questions.spanish: Mencione una guerra en la que Estados Unidos luchó durante el siglo XX.

questions.question: Why did the United States enter World War I?
answers: To support the Allied Powers (England, France, Italy, and Russia)
To oppose the Central Powers (Germany, Austria-Hungary, the Ottoman Empire, and Bulgaria)
questions.spanish: ¿Por qué entró Estados Unidos en la Primera Guerra Mundial?

questions.question: When did all women get the right to vote?
questions.spanish: ¿Cuándo obtuvieron todas las mujeres el derecho a votar?

questions.question: What was the Great Depression?
answers: Longest economic recession in modern history
questions.spanish: ¿Qué fue la Gran Depresión?

questions.question: When did the Great Depression start?
questions.spanish: ¿Cuándo comenzó la Gran Depresión?

questions.question: Who was president during the Great Depression and World War II?
questions.spanish: ¿Quién era presidente durante la Gran Depresión y la Segunda Guerra Mundial?

questions.question: Why did the United States enter World War II?
answers: To support the Allied Powers (England, France, and Russia)
To oppose the Axis Powers (Germany, Italy, and Japan)
questions.spanish: ¿Por qué entró Estados Unidos en la Segunda Guerra Mundial?

questions.question: Dwight Eisenhower is famous for many things. Name one.
answers: President at the end of (during) the Korean War
Signed the Federal-Aid Highway Act of 1956 (Created the Interstate System)
questions.spanish: Dwight Eisenhower es famoso por muchas cosas. Mencione una.

questions.question: Who was the United States’ main rival during the Cold War?
questions.spanish: ¿Quién fue el principal rival de Estados Unidos durante la Guerra Fría?

questions.question: During the Cold War, what was one main concern of the United States?
questions.spanish: Durante la Guerra Fría, ¿cuál era una de las principales preocupaciones de Estados Unidos?

questions.question: Why did the United States enter the Korean War?
answers: To stop the spread of communism
questions.spanish: ¿Por qué entró Estados Unidos en la Guerra de Corea?

questions.question: Why did the United States enter the Vietnam War?
answers: To stop the spread of communism
questions.spanish: ¿Por qué entró Estados Unidos en la Guerra de Vietnam?

questions.question: What did the civil rights movement do?
questions.spanish: ¿Qué hizo el movimiento por los derechos civiles?

questions.question: Martin Luther King, Jr. is famous for many things. Name one.
answers: Worked for equality for all Americans
Worked to ensure that people would “not be judged by the color of their skin, but by the content of their character”
questions.spanish: Martin Luther King Jr. es famoso por muchas cosas. Mencione una.

questions.question: Why did the United States enter the Persian Gulf War?
answers: To force the Iraqi military from Kuwait
questions.spanish: ¿Por qué entró Estados Unidos en la Guerra del Golfo Pérsico?

questions.question: What major event happened on September 11, 2001 in the United States?
answers: Terrorists took over two planes and crashed them into the World Trade Center in New York City
Terrorists took over a plane and crashed into the Pentagon in Arlington, Virginia
Terrorists took over a plane originally aimed at Washington, D.C., and crashed in a field in Pennsylvania
questions.spanish: ¿Qué acontecimiento importante ocurrió el 11 de septiembre de 2001 en los Estados Unidos?

questions.question: Name one U.S. military conflict after the September 11, 2001 attacks.
questions.spanish: Mencione un conflicto militar de Estados Unidos después de los ataques del 11 de septiembre de 2001.

questions.question: Name one American Indian tribe in the United States.
notes: For a complete list of tribes, please visit bia.gov.
questions.spanish: Mencione una tribu indígena estadounidense en los Estados Unidos.

questions.question: Name one example of an American innovation.
questions.spanish: Mencione un ejemplo de una innovación estadounidense.

questions.question: What is the capital of the United States?
questions.spanish: ¿Cuál es la capital de los Estados Unidos?

questions.question: Where is the Statue of Liberty?
answers: Liberty Island [Also acceptable are New Jersey, near New York City, and on the Hudson (River).]
questions.spanish: ¿Dónde está la Estatua de la Libertad?

questions.question: Why does the flag have 13 stripes?
answers: (Because the stripes) represent the original colonies
questions.spanish: ¿Por qué la bandera tiene 13 franjas?

questions.question: Why does the flag have 50 stars?
answers: (Because there is) one star for each state
questions.spanish: ¿Por qué la bandera tiene 50 estrellas?

questions.question: What is the name of the national anthem?
questions.spanish: ¿Cuál es el nombre del himno nacional?

questions.question: The Nation’s first motto was “E Pluribus Unum.” What does that mean?
questions.spanish: El primer lema de la nación fue “E Pluribus Unum”. ¿Qué significa?

questions.question: What is Independence Day?
answers: A holiday to celebrate U.S. independence (from Britain)
questions.spanish: ¿Qué es el Día de la Independencia?

questions.question: Name three national U.S. holidays.
questions.spanish: Mencione tres días festivos nacionales de los Estados Unidos.

questions.question: What is Memorial Day?
answers: A holiday to honor soldiers who died in military service
questions.spanish: ¿Qué es el Día de los Caídos (Memorial Day)?

questions.question: What is Veterans Day?
answers: A holiday to honor people in the (U.S.) military
A holiday to honor people who have served (in the U.S. military)
questions.spanish: ¿Qué es el Día de los Veteranos (Veterans Day)?
